title: Final Work Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for maximum work done by the turbine, W = 0.37 Q.

title: Temperature Conversion
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly convert the intake and exhaust temperatures from Celsius to Kelvin.

title: Clausius Formula Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Clausius formula to derive the relationship between heat input and work output.

title: Reversibility Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state that maximum work is achieved under reversible conditions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all temperatures are expressed in Kelvin and that units are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may incorrectly apply the Clausius formula leading to sign errors in the work expression.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student might overlook the factor of (1 - T2/T1) in the work calculation.
